title: ONLYOFFICE: free Microsoft Office alternative
caption:
Microsoft 365 Personal charges $99.99/year. ONLYOFFICE lets you edit Word, Excel and PowerPoint files for free 📄

✅ Edit Word, Excel and PowerPoint files, even offline
✅ PDF editor with fillable PDF forms
✅ Connect Dropbox, Nextcloud and more to work together in real time
✅ No subscription, no watermarks, 100% free

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux
ℹ️ The desktop app is free. ONLYOFFICE also sells paid cloud and server editions for businesses.
